newsitem.title: USA: US spot prods rally late day, Harbor heat diffs up.
newsitem.headline: US spot prods rally late day, Harbor heat diffs up.

text.p: U.S. spot products prices jumped higher by late day Thursday, mostly due to the sharp rally in the NYMEX futures, traders said.
New York Harbor (NYH) distillate demand also remained strong, helping boost spot market differentials.

Market players attributed the NYMEX rally to expectations for strong weather-related demand for heating oil, as well as covering of short positions ahead of the February futures' expiration on Friday.

NYH prompt No. 2 oil was offered by Sun Co. at 0.20 cent over the screen early in the day, boosting the levels about 0.10 cent from Wednesday. NYH prompt 74-grade low sulphur diesel was offered at 1.10 cent over, also up about 0.10 cent.

The early strength in jet fuel prices eased slightly by late afternoon, with prompt barrels of 54-grade talked between about 4.75 and 5.25 cents over the print. Prompt 55-grade traded at 6.85 cents over early Thursday, though offers slipped to about 6.5 cents over.

U.S. Gulf distillate diffs slipped about 0.50 cent on Thursday, with nearby No. 2 oil offered at about 4.00 cents under the screen and nearby low-sulphur diesel offered at 3.00 cents under the screen.
